heading.zh-Hant: 生平與聯邦委員會初期
heading.en: Life and early Federal Council years

body.zh-Hant: 皮萊-戈拉1889年12月31日生於科索奈，1958年4月11日卒於巴黎。他1912年取得洛桑大學法學博士並任律師；1921至1928年為沃州大議會的自由派議員，1925至1928年任國民院議員。1928年12月13日當選聯邦委員會委員，接替沃州人舒阿爾；1929年主管內政部，1930至1939年主管郵政與鐵路部。
body.en: Pilet-Golaz was born at Cossonay on 31 December 1889 and died in Paris on 11 April 1958. He took a doctorate in law at the University of Lausanne in 1912 and practised as a lawyer. He sat as a Radical in the Vaud Grand Council in 1921–1928 and in the National Council in 1925–1928. On 13 December 1928 he was elected to the Federal Council as successor to the Vaudois Ernest Chuard; he headed the Department of the Interior in 1929 and the Post and Railways Department in 1930–1939.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年3月2日，皮萊-戈拉接替莫塔，出任政治部（外交部）首長。他1940年6月25日發表演說，其中關於以威權方式更新民主的含糊言論引發疑慮。1944年12月，在恢復與莫斯科關係的嘗試失敗後，公眾信任喪失，他因而辭職。
body.en: On 2 March 1940 Pilet-Golaz succeeded Giuseppe Motta at the head of the Political Department. In his address of 25 June 1940 ambiguous remarks about an authoritarian renewal of democracy raised doubts. In December 1944, after the attempt to resume relations with Moscow had failed, loss of public confidence led to his resignation.

body.zh-Hant: 1912年11月28日，弗洛拉國民大會宣告成立第一個國家政府；12月4日選出臨時政府，其總理為捷馬利。研究指出，臨時政府由他領導；奧斯曼方面視獨立宣告為叛國。1912至1913年冬，吉諾卡斯特、特佩萊納與佩爾梅特承認他為總理。
body.en: On 28 November 1912 the National Assembly of Vlora declared the establishment of the first national government, and on 4 December 1912 the Provisional Government was elected, with Ismail Qemali as its Prime Minister. A scholarly study describes the government as headed by him and notes that the Ottoman side treated the declaration of independence as treason. In the winter of 1912–1913 Gjirokastra, Tepelena and Përmet recognised him as Prime Minister.

heading.en: Life and political career in outline

body.zh-Hant: 西蒙伊-塞馬達姆1864年3月23日生於切斯內克，1946年6月4日卒於布達佩斯。1901年他以人民黨綱領當選議員；1920年任第一屆國民議會副議長，1920年3月15日至7月19日任首相，並在4月19日前暫時兼管內政與外交部。他是基督教民族聯合黨的領導人之一，1921年春加入小農黨，1922年後退出政治活動，並自1922年起任四人財政委員會成員、自1932年起任匈牙利抵押信貸銀行政府專員。
body.en: Simonyi-Semadam was born at Csesznek on 23 March 1864 and died in Budapest on 4 June 1946. He became a deputy in 1901 on a People’s Party programme; in 1920 he was vice-president of the first National Assembly and prime minister from 15 March to 19 July 1920, also holding the interior and foreign portfolios on an interim basis until 19 April. He was one of the leaders of the Christian National Union Party, joined the Smallholders’ Party in spring 1921 and withdrew from political activity after 1922; he sat on the four-member National Financial Council from 1922 and was government commissioner of the Hungarian Mortgage Credit Bank from 1932.

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾貝一世在洛里昂受軍事訓練；1870年普法戰爭期間，這位後來的在位親王在法國海軍擔任海軍上尉。他與德皇威廉二世保持密切關係。1903年2月20日，他以敕令創設國際和平研究所，並委託加斯東·莫克負責。
body.en: Albert I received his training at Lorient; during the Franco-German war of 1870 the future reigning prince served as a lieutenant de vaisseau in the French navy. As sovereign he maintained close relations with Emperor Wilhelm II. In 1903 he created the International Institute of Peace by an ordinance of 20 February and entrusted its direction to Gaston Moch.
